themes.name: [Negative] Poor Customer Support and Experience

quotes.text: Customer service of Zerodha is very pathetic

I added funds via upi method and they are claiming as they add instant fund to your demat account but after 30 minutes i have not received my funds in my demat account or not also received back to my back account
I requested for call back, they do not call back and you keep on waiting and waiting and waiting
After the last update, I'm facing an issue with the withdrawal request feature.
Whenever I submit a payment withdrawal request, the app initially shows an error saying the request could not be processed.
I'm not receiving UPI mandate for IPO.
Unable to create new account using Google pay. Even though the joining rs 1 transaction is successful, the website shows payment failed and am unable to create my account.
Add funds not working giving unexpected error occurred.
The account is not being activated even after writing repeatedly and submitting KYC documents.

zerodha kite claude ke saath connect nahi ho raha hai. jo aapne video me bataya vahi kiya fir bhi nahi ho raha hai error aa rahi hai Claude esa bol raha hai . 'please log in first' ya 'session not found' error aata hai
aajkal chart IQ per koi bhi line draw karna
kite app me multiple chart lagane ka option hi nhi hai , chart sabse acha DHAN ka hai, please usme multiple chart lagane ka option laiye jaldi

Zerodha bilkul hi bkwas hai. Dusre broker apne account ko ek sath multiple jgh handling krne deta hai. yhan bus ek hi system pr rho. Stop loss aur order lgana to 'So.. horrible' hai. itna janjat bkwas matha pschchi hai ki kya btayen. time pr entry exit stoploss nhi lga pate. 000000 zero hai
bar bar 300 sec bta rha h. login hi nhi krne de rha. 1 hour ho gya. kya ghatiya app h
aare bhai apps to instal hee nahi ho raha hai yaar

आपके app chart में हर बार trendlines गायब हो जाती हैं । बार बार draw करना पड़ रहा , मार्केट बंद होने के बाद chart सही से लोड नहीं होता zero zero ho जाता है । scalper mood भी देना चाहिए क्योंकि options में Jada ट्रेड होता है।, इंटरफेस अच्छा है सिंपल है । मोबाइल phone से trade करना बोहोत मुश्किल है नहीं कर सकते chart के लिए दूसरा application देखना पड़ेगा। Zerodha please solve this issues.

themes.description: Users expressed extreme frustration with various aspects of customer support, including lack of responsiveness, long waiting times, unhelpfulness, and inadequate contact information.
themes.business_impact: This theme could lead to a significant loss of customer trust and, ultimately, a decline in customer retention and revenue.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause of this issue appears to be a lack of investment in support infrastructure, staffing, and training, leading to high employee turnover and inadequate customer service.
themes.action_plan:
• Invest in the support team, including training and hiring more staff
• Improve communication channels, such as live chat
• Implement a more robust ticketing system
• Establish clear contact information and response times
